from collections import deque
def comps(g,color,conn=8):
    seen=set(); res=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c]==color and (r,c) not in seen:
                q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy in range(-1,2):
                        for dx in range(-1,2):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<len(g) and 0<=nx<len(g[0]) and g[ny][nx]==color and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                                seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                res.append(cells)
    return res
def norm(cells):
    ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
    return frozenset((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells)
def transforms(cells):
    s=norm(cells); out=set()
    cur=s
    for _ in range(4):
        for c in (cur, frozenset((y,max(x for _,x in cur)-x) for y,x in cur)):
            out.add(c)
        cur=frozenset((x,max(y for y,_ in cur)-y) for y,x in cur)
